title: A Echo for the Gravity
author: Casper Yarrow
blurb: Vesper Ravensworth, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
